newsitem.title: GREECE: AGRICULTURAL BANK STREAMLINES TO ENTER BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: AGRICULTURAL BANK STREAMLINES TO ENTER BOURSE.

text.p: The Agricultural Bank of Greece (ATE) is undergoing streamlining, eyeing its listing in the Athens stock exchange in the next five years, the state Athens News Agency (ANA) said on Thursday.
"Shares will be given at an attractive price to financially healthy agricultural, credit and consumer cooperatives," governor Christos Papathanasiou told a news conference.
The bank was in the process of liquidating 30 of its holdings in agricultural and livestock firms to achieve its objective, Papathanasiou said.
ATE's restructuring will be handled by a consortium of advisers who will take over within the next few months.
The bank is already expanding its activities both in the Greek agricultural sector and in Balkan and eastern European countries.
